// --- Kernel entry point ---
extern "C" __aicore__ __attribute__((always_inline)) void kernel_entry(__gm__ int64_t* args)
{
#if !defined(__CPU_SIM) && !defined(__COSTMODEL)
    // Reset AI Core atomic mode inherited from a prior kernel.
    set_atomic_none();
#endif

#if defined(__DAV_CUBE__) && !defined(__CPU_SIM) && !defined(__COSTMODEL)
    // Start cube tasks in FP32 mode, independent of a prior task's HF32 setting.
    set_ctrl(sbitset0(get_ctrl(), pto::MAD_MODE_BIT));
#endif

    // Read logical SPMD block identity from runtime dispatch payload
    int32_t __pypto_spmd_block_idx = get_block_idx(args);
    int32_t __pypto_spmd_block_num = get_block_num(args);

    // Unpack tensor: recv_count_local_inline472__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* recv_count_local_inline472__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[0]);
    __gm__ int32_t* recv_count_local_inline472__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ int32_t*>(recv_count_local_inline472__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + recv_count_local_inline472__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack tensor: recv_meta_local_inline473__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* recv_meta_local_inline473__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[1]);
    __gm__ int32_t* recv_meta_local_inline473__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ int32_t*>(recv_meta_local_inline473__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + recv_meta_local_inline473__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack tensor: recv_route_local_inline471__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* recv_route_local_inline471__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[2]);
    __gm__ int32_t* recv_route_local_inline471__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ int32_t*>(recv_route_local_inline471__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + recv_route_local_inline471__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack tensor: partial_inline666__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* partial_inline666__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[3]);
    __gm__ float* partial_inline666__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ float*>(partial_inline666__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + partial_inline666__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack tensor: routed_output__ssa_v0
    __gm__ Tensor* routed_output__ssa_v0_tensor = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ Tensor*>(args[4]);
    __gm__ bfloat16_t* routed_output__ssa_v0 = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ bfloat16_t*>(routed_output__ssa_v0_tensor->buffer.addr) + routed_output__ssa_v0_tensor->start_offset;

    // Unpack CommContext: routed_output_ctx
    __gm__ int64_t* routed_output_ctx = reinterpret_cast<__gm__ int64_t*>(args[5]);

    // Extract dynamic dim: V41_ROUTE_T_DYN
    int64_t V41_ROUTE_T_DYN = static_cast<int64_t>(routed_output__ssa_v0_tensor->shapes[0]);

    // Forward to ptoas-generated function
    ffn_reduce_scatter(recv_count_local_inline472__ssa_v0, recv_meta_local_inline473__ssa_v0, recv_route_local_inline471__ssa_v0, partial_inline666__ssa_v0, routed_output__ssa_v0, routed_output_ctx, V41_ROUTE_T_DYN, __pypto_spmd_block_idx, __pypto_spmd_block_num);
}
